description: Fetch a county's County Distress Index (CDI) scorecard by 5-digit FIPS code. Returns the 0-100 score (the share of the other U.S. counties with a lower composite, rounded down; field composite_score), score label, national + state rank (national_rank_ordinal is filled only for the top and bottom 100, where the site prints it), 5-domain breakdown (Delinquency, Default & Legal, Debt Burden, Labor, Safety Net & Buffer), key findings, and pre-baked APA / MLA / Chicago / news-copy citations. Accepts 4-digit FIPS with implicit leading zero. 3,144 counties available.

fips.description: The 5-digit numeric county FIPS code as a string (e.g., '13063' for Clayton County, GA). 4-digit values are zero-padded internally. 3,144 counties available.
fips.title: Fips

name: get_county_scorecard
